A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we propose a novel CASGCN for single image super resolution, which incorporates global spatial and channel attention mechanism to model the feature correlation and obtain more powerful feature representation.

our CASGCN achieves state-of-the-art performance on all the benchmark datasets, including the most challenging real-world datasets, and is also more effective than the existing SR methods in terms of visual quality.

we propose a channel and spatial aware graph based network to effectively model global correlations for more powerful feature representation, and the proposed CASGCN achieves the state-of-the-art performance on SISR with various degradation models.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the global self similar relationship among pixels is important for SISR and the proposed CASGCN can well model such relationship.
the global spatial and channel dependencies can be modeled by a simple and effective CASG block, which can be easily incorporated into any existing SISR network to boost the performance.
channel and spatial attention are complementary to each other in SISR and can be jointly exploited to boost the performance of SR networks.
